entries.sql: WITH RECURSIVE tree AS (SELECT __n.id AS id, 1 AS __depth, ARRAY[__n.id] AS __visited FROM users AS __n WHERE false UNION ALL SELECT __n.id AS id, tree.__depth + 1 AS __depth, tree.__visited || __n.id AS __visited FROM tree JOIN edges AS __e ON __e.from_id = tree.id JOIN users AS __n ON __n.id = __e.to_id WHERE tree.__depth < 2 AND __n.id <> ALL (tree.__visited)) SELECT tree.id AS id FROM tree
